Overall verdict: needs_changes.

FINDING (medium, security): Security documentation overstates the no-target-repo-write boundary. Evidence: [DASHBOARD_PROJECT_SELECTOR.md]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/docs/DASHBOARD_PROJECT_SELECTOR.md:210) says “Every write target is rooted at `global_config.dontpanic_home()`,” but [single-repo-fallback-log.txt]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/docs/plans/2026-05-23-005-feat-dashboard-project-selector-v0/evidence/single-repo-fallback-log.txt:9) shows unregistered current-repo fallback writes `<repo>/dashboard/state`. Recommendation: clarify that registered project/fleet mode writes operator-local cache, while legacy single-repo fallback still writes repo-local dashboard state.

FINDING (low, test_coverage): The 8-project synthetic fleet evidence does not demonstrate the richer state mix implied by the evidence harness and feature refs. Evidence: [fleet-summary-8-project-snapshot.json]($HOME/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/docs/plans/2026-05-23-005-feat-dashboard-project-selector-v0/evidence/fleet-summary-8-project-snapshot.json:1) only contains `advisory` and `quiet` health bands; no `needs_action`, `ready`, or explicit stale-state case appears. Recommendation: either adjust the claim to “8 projects with inactive and missing-repo cases” or extend the fixture to include the claimed bands/stale case.
